focus: Root-file traps, cross-runtime wiring, and the doc discovery path
noveltyJustification: All 8 findings were new to this lineage; the install-route discovery gap and the root-file silence had not been examined in earlier iterations.
answeredQuestions: Q4: Which root-file and cross-runtime traps (`AGENTS.md`, `REPO RULES.md`, `.opencode/scripts`, fork-drifted files) must the engine handle before an external repo can adopt it safely?

keyFindings.text: `.opencode/scripts` needs no engine change: the engine already refuses a folder where upstream ships a file with a message that names the fix (`list it in repin.exclude to keep it`), and refuses unowned drift with `move each edit into an overlay, list the path in repin.exclude, or restore it from <pin>`, so Barter's `tar --exclude .opencode/scripts` becomes a manifest `repin.exclude` entry. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:2671] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:2969] [SOURCE: /Users/michelkerkmeester/MEGA/Development/Skilled/barter/ai-speckit/skilled/barter-overlays/README.md:94]

The engine refuses when the overlay folder sits inside a folder a re-pin copies, and Barter's `barter-overlays/` sits at the tree root outside `.skilled` and the runtime folders, so `.skilled-overlays.json` naming it is the only missing piece for adoption — no engine change is needed for placement. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:2961] [SOURCE: /Users/michelkerkmeester/MEGA/Development/Skilled/barter/ai-speckit/skilled/barter-overlays/overlay-manifest.json:1]

Root files are structurally outside the re-pin copy and delete sets, which makes Barter's documented whole-archive trap impossible through the engine, but the same exclusion means an upstream change to a root file is never applied and no report line says so; the reference doc states `Root files such as AGENTS.md are never copied` as a fact rather than as a warning that those changes are dropped. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:2531] [SOURCE: /Users/michelkerkmeester/MEGA/Development/Skilled/barter/ai-speckit/skilled/barter-overlays/README.md:186] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skilled-doctor/references/overlays.md:120]

`AGENTS.md` and `REPO RULES.md` have a second owner: `/doctor:agents-md check` reports twelve rows including `REPO RULES.md`, so after a re-pin two commands own the same root files and neither the router docs nor the reference states which one wins. [SOURCE: README.md:1452] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:2531]

`.dsh` is treated inconsistently inside Skilled itself: the overlay guard ships a dsh adapter, so dsh edits are protected, while the engine's default runtime folder list omits `.dsh`, so dsh mirrors are skipped on re-pin unless the manifest overrides `repin.runtimeFolders`. [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/overlay-guard/dsh/overlay-guard.mjs:1] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:74]

The advertised install route never mentions overlays: `/doctor:install` has zero overlay mentions, and the install, setup and helper workflow assets have none either, while root README section 5 documents `status`, `apply`, `--capture` and `repin` in full — so a repo that follows the install path never discovers the feature it needs. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/install.md:1] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-install.yaml:1] [SOURCE: README.md:300]

The overlays reference already documents the setting, `protectedPaths` with the literal `references/barter-design-tokens.md` example, `repin.exclude` and the root-file rule, so the brief's "docs only advertise linking" is false for that file; what is genuinely missing is adoption guidance for a repo that already has a hand-rolled overlay folder, manifest extensions and a state file. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skilled-doctor/references/overlays.md:44] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skilled-doctor/references/overlays.md:92] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skilled-doctor/references/overlays.md:120]

Fork-drifted tracking has no engine and no documentation expression: Barter's fork adds the state and validates `outsideCertificate` reasons, while the engine ignores both keys, so a migrating repo deletes those declarations and loses the only visibility it had into upstream-vs-fork divergence. [SOURCE: /Users/michelkerkmeester/MEGA/Development/Skilled/barter/ai-speckit/skilled/barter-overlays/sync.cjs:402] [SOURCE: /Users/michelkerkmeester/MEGA/Development/Skilled/barter/ai-speckit/skilled/barter-overlays/replay.cjs:813] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:67]

ruledOut: Expecting the engine to need a root-file copy rule
Expecting the docs to be silent about overlays
Expecting .opencode/scripts and .dsh to be engine features
Searching update.md, symlink.md, runtime-mirrors.md and env.md for overlay mentions
